```python
class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.generation = 0
        self.rows = []
        self.decisions = {}
        self.busy = False
        self._status = None
        self._completion_delivered = False
        self._finish_accepted = False

    def start(self):
        self.generation += 1
        self.busy = True
        self._status = "running"
        self._completion_delivered = False
        self._finish_accepted = False
        return self.generation

    def poll_status(self, generation, status):
        if generation != self.generation:
            return False
        if status == "completed":
            if self._status == "running" and not self._completion_delivered:
                self._completion_delivered = True
                return True
            return False
        if status in ("queued", "running"):
            self._status = status
            return False
        if status == "failed":
            self._status = status
            self.busy = False
            return False
        return False

    def finish(self, generation, rows):
        if generation != self.generation:
            return False
        if self._status != "completed" or self._finish_accepted or not self.busy:
            return False
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self._finish_accepted = True
        self.busy = False
        return True

    def set_decision(self, job_id, value):
        self.decisions[job_id] = value
```
